description: This file defines the 'Trend' class, which provides methods for performing different types of trend analysis (e.g., linear, logarithmic, exponential, polynomial) within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes constants for each trend type, internal caching, and methods for calculating the best-fit trend model based on input data.

classes.name: Trend
classes.description: Class for performing various trend analysis types and selecting the best fit.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Performs the trend calculation based on specified trend type, data values, and options; supports multiple trend models and selects the best fit when requested.
